candidates.title: Laboratory Technician C - Water Lab
candidates.employer_note: A separate analytical laboratory; this is not an E3 Lithium position.
candidates.level: Entry level. Chemical degree/diploma or equivalent experience; previous laboratory experience is an asset and training is provided.
candidates.summary: Prepare and test water samples to produce reliable analytical results.
duties: Prepare samples, reagents, standards and calibration solutions.
Use IC and ICP instruments under senior staff guidance.
Record test results and assist with instrument calibration and maintenance.
candidates.connection: Editorial interpretation: separation work also needs trustworthy measurements. This adds a local technical route for testing liquids alongside the existing engineering and plant-operation examples.
candidates.limit: No evidence of lithium testing or a relationship with E3. A laboratory role profile and story link would need to be created during a separately authorized implementation.
candidates.status_note: Employer-hosted description included an empty application form and Submit Application control in the retrieved HTML. No applicant data entered or sent; submission not tested.
score_why: Shares sample analysis and reliable measurement methods.
Preparation, instruments and quality procedures are explicit.
Adds a Calgary entry-level diploma-or-equivalent technical route.

candidates.title: Environmental Technician
candidates.employer_note: A separate environmental employer; this is not a Wilder Institute position.
candidates.location: Calgary, Alberta, with travel for fieldwork.
candidates.arrangement: Permanent full-time; approximately 70% fieldwork and 30% office support.
candidates.level: Experience with surveys and reporting is sought, but the posting says exact experience is not required. No numeric experience minimum or specific credential is stated; professional-registration eligibility is requested.
candidates.summary: Collect field evidence about wildlife and habitats to inform environmental decisions.
duties: Perform wildlife sweeps, nest searches and targeted species surveys.
Assess wetlands and other biological features.
Analyze field observations and prepare technical reports and mitigation recommendations.
candidates.connection: Editorial interpretation: offers a Calgary comparison for observing animals and habitats outside a conservation-breeding programme.
candidates.limit: Not evidence of owl head-starting or a Wilder partnership. Page heading says Environmental Technician; body says Environmental Field Technician. Do not label it a student job.
candidates.status_note: Original employer description explicitly invites applications by email. No email sent; posting publication date and deadline absent.
score_why: Shares wildlife observation and habitat assessment methods.
Surveys, field analysis and reports are explicit.
Adds technician-level fieldwork; some overlap with the earlier pending senior consultancy candidates.
